verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack that Pydantic AI (or its Logfire integration) offers a webhook subscription mechanism for agent events; the docs cover message history, tracing to Logfire, MCP client support, and CLI tools but never mention webhooks or event push notifications. Since agentic platforms/frameworks could plausibly expose such an integration point, this is an applicable but unevidenced capability rather than a category error.
